newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Defiance repeats Bunge offer too low.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Defiance repeats Bunge offer too low.

text.p: Baking and milling group Defiance Mills Ltd on Monday repeated its statement that the proposed takeover offer by Bunge Corp was too low.
"Defiance Mills' directors are of the view that Bunge's proposed offers fall far short of the true value of the company," Defiance said after a board meeting on Monday.

The price of about A$43 million negotiated last week for the sale of the group's New Zealand milling and baking operations to Goodman Fielders Ltd exposed Bunge's bid of A$93 million for all Defiance's businesses as seriously undervalued, chairman Tom O'Brien said in a statement.
Defiance's board advised shareholders to take no action until it fully considers the offers and makes a recommendation.

Defiance said it appointed as corporate advisers Brisbane stockbrokers, Lance Jones Ltd and Morgan Stockbroking, Sydney merchant bankers, County NatWest, and solicitors, Allen Allen & Hemsley, and Chapman Tripp Sheffield Young in New Zealand.
Bunge has said it proposes to offer A$1.70 cash for each Defiance ordinary share. It will also make cash offers for the group's Australian and New Zealand preference shares.
Defiance shares fell eight cents to A$1.90 on Monday.
